gloss: to ambush; to lie in wait for

definitions.gloss: to ambush; to lie in wait for
definitions.explanation: To hide and wait for someone to come by, either with hostile intent or simply to intercept them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{伏|ふ}せて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal was lying in wait for the victim in a dark alley.

examples.japanese: ⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名人|ゆうめいじん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{伏|ふ}せて、⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: Fans waited at the exit to intercept the celebrity and ask for an autograph.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait) and ⟦{伏|ふ}せる→伏せる：11515_fuseru⟧ (to lie face down, to conceal). The word conveys hiding in a concealed position and waiting for a target to appear. While the core meaning involves hostile ambush (military, criminal), it is also used more casually for intercepting someone, such as fans waiting for a celebrity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {待|ま}ち{伏|ふ}せ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: ambush attack
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{待|ま}ち{伏|ふ}せる: to lie in wait on the way home
- ⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{待|ま}ち{伏|ふ}せる: to wait at the exit to intercept

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{潜伏|せんぷく}する→潜伏する：25505_senpukusuru⟧: to lie hidden — emphasizes the hiding itself, not the waiting to ambush
- ⟦{襲撃|しゅうげき}→襲撃：14127_shuugeki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to attack; to raid — focuses on the attack action, not the lying in wait
- {張|は}り{込|こ}む: to stake out — used by police or detectives watching a location for a suspect
